bannedComboCheck.note: Warm light base counts as the one allowed item; headings are Archivo Black (sans), buttons are 10px rectangles, hero is a 5-tile mosaic, not a boxed photo.

colour: Light warm base #FBF7EF + deep teal #0B4F4A / #0E5F5A + coral accent #E85D4E (no orange UI accents)
fonts: Archivo Black (display) + Work Sans (body) via Google Fonts
hero: Photo mosaic (bento: headline cell + 5 grooming close-up tiles, not a single boxed photo)
honestyNotes: No invented reviews, ratings, prices, awards, staff names (Kian Griffiths named only via the verified 'Sit, Paws and Listen' podcast mention in research), certifications or numbers. Google review count NOT VERIFIED — no Google count appears anywhere. 'Prices on request' appears exactly once, in the prices section. Footer-only disclaimer: 'Design concept by CodeCrafters Hub — not the official website of Vanity Furrr'. No concept badges in hero/header.
imageNotes: Every photo viewed on contact sheets before use. Rejected: vet-exam photo (6235119), human hair/brushing photos (7020324, 5468620, 3356170, 32329615), dental model (9951396), baby/child photos (8655017, 10566139, 27086424), horse (29568247), lions (35037978), elephants (21974054, 25754094), alpaca (12164253), sheep (17994537), food bowl (8434635), dog-walking photos (30638238, 36192733), bathroom interiors and human spa photos (6634907, 6634828, 18161061, 7622547), silly-costume dogs (4588005, 34531302, 8994367), and golden-puppy-running (12538668) — swapped out after self-review because a second puppy is half-cut at the frame edge. The two-small-dogs 1600px file was softened with a light blur (radius 1.0) to fit under 250 KB; it still clearly shows both dogs. All kept photos are Pexels free-licensed, converted locally to WebP 1600px + 800px srcset, every file under 250 KB, no image repeated on the site. Gallery and compare slider are labelled illustrative; no photo is presented as the salon's own.
